verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Open WebUI is self-hosted and "built to run entirely offline," and that it connects to Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers for local models. Air-gapped deployment is also documented, which covers the no-cloud-dependency requirement. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming llama.cpp, LM Studio, and vLLM (support is only implied through OpenAI-compatible APIs), independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully local, offline setup.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can run the assistant entirely on local models — Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM — with no cloud model dependency

citations.quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
With support for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, it gives you a powerful, provider-agnostic interface for both local and cloud-based models.
connects to Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, and Open Responses providers out of the box
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
